hook: Leverage is easy. Not getting liquidated while you sleep is the hard part.
body: When volatility hits unattended positions, delayed intervention risks cascading insolvencies. In Vanna's composable credit infrastructure, risk is stopped at the boundary. The liquidation threshold enforces a 1.1x health factor floor before capital breaches parity. Every calculation uses floor division—mul_wad_down and div_wad_down—to prevent rounding in the protocol's favour. Governed by policy-bounded autonomous risk management within unified margin accounts, distress is isolated before it spreads.
